package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/workercontrol"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/workertransport"
)

type probeResult struct {
	AttemptID          uuid.UUID                       `json:"attempt_id"`
	JobID              uuid.UUID                       `json:"job_id"`
	WorkerID           uuid.UUID                       `json:"worker_id"`
	WorkerEpoch        int64                           `json:"worker_epoch"`
	LeaseFence         int64                           `json:"lease_fence"`
	LeaseToken         string                          `json:"lease_token,omitempty"`
	StartDecision      workercontrol.StartDecision     `json:"start_decision,omitempty"`
	HeartbeatDecision  workercontrol.HeartbeatDecision `json:"heartbeat_decision,omitempty"`
	FailureDisposition workercontrol.RetryDisposition  `json:"failure_disposition,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	credentials, err := workertransport.NewClientTLSCredentials(
		os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_TLS_CERT_FILE"),
		os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_TLS_KEY_FILE"),
		os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_TLS_ROOT_CA_FILE"),
		os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_TLS_SERVER_NAME"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	client, err := workertransport.DialClient(
		ctx,
		os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_CONTROL_ADDRESS"),
		credentials,
	)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = client.Close() }()
	workerEpoch, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_EPOCH"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	switch os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_PROBE_ACTION") {
	case "start":
		runStart(ctx, client, workerEpoch)
	case "heartbeat-fail":
		runHeartbeatAndFail(ctx, client, workerEpoch)
	default:
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("unknown Worker probe action"))
	}
}

func runStart(ctx context.Context, client *workertransport.Client, workerEpoch int64) {
	assignment, err := client.Acquire(ctx, workerEpoch)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	lease := workercontrol.LeaseCredentials{
		AttemptID:   assignment.AttemptID,
		WorkerEpoch: assignment.WorkerEpoch,
		Fence:       assignment.LeaseFence,
		Token:       assignment.LeaseToken,
	}
	started, err := client.Start(ctx, lease)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	heartbeat, err := client.Heartbeat(ctx, lease, heartbeatObservation(1))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	writeResult(probeResult{
		AttemptID:         assignment.AttemptID,
		JobID:             assignment.JobID,
		WorkerID:          assignment.WorkerID,
		WorkerEpoch:       assignment.WorkerEpoch,
		LeaseFence:        assignment.LeaseFence,
		LeaseToken:        assignment.LeaseToken,
		StartDecision:     started.Decision,
		HeartbeatDecision: heartbeat.Decision,
	})
}

func runHeartbeatAndFail(ctx context.Context, client *workertransport.Client, workerEpoch int64) {
	leaseFence, err := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("VELA_LEASE_FENCE"), 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	lease := workercontrol.LeaseCredentials{
		AttemptID:   uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_ATTEMPT_ID")),
		WorkerEpoch: workerEpoch,
		Fence:       leaseFence,
		Token:       os.Getenv("VELA_LEASE_TOKEN"),
	}
	heartbeat, err := client.Heartbeat(ctx, lease, heartbeatObservation(2))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	decision, err := client.Fail(ctx, lease, workercontrol.FailureObservation{
		FailureClass:             "FATAL_BACKEND",
		FailureFingerprint:       "slice29.nminusone.normal-terminal",
		ErrorSummary:             "N-1 Worker ended its active rollout conformance task",
		BackendStage:             "generation",
		GPUUUIDs:                 []string{"GPU-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"},
		InferenceBackendRevision: "sglang-vela@slice29-n-minus-one",
		RetryRecommended:         false,
		WorkerReusable:           true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	writeResult(probeResult{
		AttemptID:          heartbeat.AttemptID,
		JobID:              heartbeat.JobID,
		WorkerID:           heartbeat.WorkerID,
		WorkerEpoch:        heartbeat.WorkerEpoch,
		LeaseFence:         heartbeat.LeaseFence,
		HeartbeatDecision:  heartbeat.Decision,
		FailureDisposition: decision.Disposition,
	})
}

func heartbeatObservation(sequence int64) workercontrol.HeartbeatObservation {
	return workercontrol.HeartbeatObservation{
		Sequence:               sequence,
		BackendStage:           "generation",
		GPUHealthSummary:       json.RawMessage(`{"healthy":true}`),
		LocalArtifactState:     json.RawMessage(`{"state":"active"}`),
		ScratchFreeBytes:       1 << 36,
		ArtifactStoreReachable: true,
	}
}

func writeResult(result probeResult) {
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
